correctness.rationale: Coarea gives the radial boundary point X(u)=2^d f_u(0)u for the density of the sum of independent uniforms with coefficients u_i. Conditioning on the summands other than i gives 2|u_i|f_u(0)=Pr(|S|≤|u_i|) when u_i is nonzero. The support is the entire interval with half-width sum_{j≠i}|u_j|, and the density is positive inside unless all other coefficients vanish, which gives equality directly. This proves both the facet offsets and their closed crosspolytope shapes, including the intervals for d=2. On each open sign and subset-sum chamber the density is a polynomial of degree d−1 divided by a constant times the coordinate product, by inclusion-exclusion on the box followed by differentiation. A hyperplane containing its radial image cannot pass through the origin and, written L(x)=1, forces L times that polynomial to equal a nonzero multiple of the coordinate product. Unique factorization forces L to be proportional to one coordinate. The conditioning formula is strictly increasing in that positive coefficient below dominance when the others are held fixed, so the chamber lies on the stated coordinate facet only. To verify the passage to algebraic components independently, the chamber images are Euclidean dense in the boundary by continuity of radial parametrization. Their finite union has the same Zariski closure as the whole boundary. Each chamber closure is irreducible (its ideal is the kernel of evaluation into the rational function field on a coordinate chart); its dimension is d−1 because the rational map on u_d=±1 has a rational inverse via coordinate ratios. Therefore a hyperplane component must be one of these chamber closures; each coordinate facet contributes a full hyperplane by relative openness and the dimension bound. Busemann convexity then identifies the listed sections as all facets. The hyperplane Jacobian is |det A|/||A^Tv|| for unit v, which gives the asserted contravariant transformation and preserves the classification for nonsingular A. This is an all-dimensional proof check, not an extrapolation from the frozen numerical diagnostics.
